content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user viewing the task report","i_want":"to filter the report tasks by Status, Priority and Date Range","so_that":"I see only the tasks that match the condition I need to review","business_description":"The task report lets the user narrow the list of tasks by Status (Open, In Progress, Completed), Priority (Low, Medium, High) and a Date Range. The filters apply to the report table and to the report API that serves it.","business_value":"Users can find the tasks they need to act on without scanning the full list, which reduces the time spent reviewing tasks.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"The report contains tasks with Open, In Progress and Completed status","when":"The user selects the status filter value Open on the reporting page","then":"The report table lists only tasks whose status is Open and no other tasks"},{"given":"The report contains tasks with Low, Medium and High priority","when":"The user selects the priority filter value High on the reporting page","then":"The report table lists only tasks whose priority is High and no other tasks"},{"given":"The report contains tasks with dates both inside and outside a chosen range","when":"The user sets a Date Range on the reporting page","then":"The report table lists only tasks whose date value, for the date field confirmed in the open question in the edge cases, falls inside the range"},{"given":"The status filter is Open and the priority filter is High","when":"The user applies both filters together on the reporting page","then":"The report table lists only tasks that are both Open and High priority"},{"given":"The report API is called with a status, a priority or a date range filter","when":"The request is sent with one or more filter values","then":"The response contains only the tasks that match all filter values sent, and the count in the response equals the number of returned tasks"},{"given":"A filter request to the report API fails with an error response","when":"The user changes a filter on the reporting page","then":"The table does not show the filtered result as applied, and the page shows an error state instead of a success state"}],"edge_cases":["The PRD does not state which task date (Creation Date, Due Date, Last Updated Date or Completion Date) the Date Range filter applies to. This is an open question. The date field must be confirmed before the date range filter is implemented; until then no date field is assumed.","A Date Range whose start date is later than its end date is rejected with an invalid input error and the table is not filtered.","A status or priority filter value outside Open, In Progress, Completed or Low, Medium, High is rejected with an invalid input error.","When no filter is selected, the report returns all tasks.","A task with no value in the confirmed date field is excluded from any date range result."],"dependencies":["US-create-task","US-view-task-report"],"definition_of_done":["The report endpoint from US-view-task-report accepts status, priority and date range parameters, and the filters combine with the search and sort parameters on the same endpoint.","The date field used by the Date Range filter is confirmed and documented in the task.","Invalid filter values return an error response that follows the backend error handling approach.","The Status, Priority and Date Range controls are on the report page and send their values to the report endpoint.","When the filter request fails, the page shows an error state and does not show the filtered result as applied.","No filtered result is shown as successful before the backend responds successfully."]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"report-endpoint-filter-parameters","title":"[BE] Add status, priority and date range filters to the report endpoint","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Extend the single report endpoint created by US-view-task-report with optional status, priority and date range query parameters. The filters are combinable with the search and sort parameters on the same endpoint. Status and priority values are validated against the allowed values. The date range is applied to the date field confirmed for this story. Invalid values return an error through the shared error handling.","size":"M","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-5f4ef76c","R-8007d6b5"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["The report endpoint accepts optional status, priority, date range start and date range end parameters.","Filters are combined with search and sort parameters on the same endpoint.","Status and priority values outside the allowed values return an invalid input error.","A start date later than the end date returns an invalid input error.","The response count equals the number of returned tasks.","The date field used for the range is documented in the code and the story."]},{"key_slug":"report-filter-controls","title":"[FE] Add Status, Priority and Date Range filter controls to the report page","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"Add Status and Priority selectors and a Date Range control to the task report page. Selecting or changing a filter sends the values to the report endpoint. The table shows the filtered result only after the backend responds successfully. On failure the page shows an error state.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-5f4ef76c"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Status filter offers Open, In Progress and Completed.","Priority filter offers Low, Medium and High.","Date Range control sends a start and end value to the report endpoint.","The table is not updated as applied when the filter request fails.","An error state is shown when the filter request fails.","Loading state is shown while a filter request is in progress."]},{"key_slug":"report-filter-test-suite","title":"[QA] Add test suite for report filters across API and report page","track":"qa_general","area":"qa","description":"Write the test suite for the report filters covering the API filter parameters, combined filters, invalid values, and the report page filter controls including the error path.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-5f4ef76c","R-8007d6b5"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Tests cover status, priority and date range filters individually and combined.","Tests cover invalid filter values and a start date later than the end date.","Tests cover the error state when the filter request fails and confirm no filtered result is shown as applied.","Test suite runs in the continuous integration pipeline and passes."]}]}
